parameters: \rI've been waiting for a Trainer with a burning-hot soul.
\rHow can you oppose Mega Evolution that can freeze everything?
\rDo you intend to thaw my very heart?\nThat actually wouldn't bother me.
\rAnyway, continue onward!\nDrake is waiting for you as well.
\rWelcome, my name is Glacia\nof the Elite Four.
\rI've traveled from afar to Hoenn\nso that I may hone my ice skills.
\rBut all I have seen are challenges by\nweak Trainers and their POKéMON.
\rIt would please me to no end if I could\ngo all out against you!
everything here before the door opens is meant

it's so long that it was split out into normal text
\rIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.
\rAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON League.
